text: Boris Vidgof holds a controlling 94.74% stake in OOO 'Bovid'.

source.name: Checko — OOO '"Bovid"' (EGRUL data)
source.quote: Контрольная доля принадлежит Видгофу Борису Ефимовичу (94,74%)
source.note: Russian; 'The controlling share belongs to Boris Efimovich Vidgof (94.74%)'. The same page lists company president Boris Vidgof and general director Mikhail Vidgof. No publication dateline; the page states 'As of 3 October 2026 the company is active' (na 3 oktyabrya 2026 goda).
